question: Employer partners in the healthcare sector
cypher:
MATCH (col:College {name: $college})-[:IN_MARKET]->(r:Region)<-[:IN_MARKET]-(emp:Employer)-[:HIRES_FOR]->(occ:Occupation)-[:REQUIRES_SKILL]->(sk:Skill)<-[:DEVELOPS]-(course:Course {college: $college})
WHERE toLower(emp.sector) CONTAINS 'health'
RETURN emp.name AS name, emp.sector AS sector, emp.description AS description,
       emp.website AS website,
       collect(DISTINCT occ.title) AS occupations,
       count(DISTINCT sk) AS matching_skills,
       collect(DISTINCT sk.name) AS skills
ORDER BY matching_skills DESC
interpretation: This query finds all healthcare sector employers in College of the Desert's regional labor market and ranks them by how many skills — required for their job openings — are actively taught in College of the Desert's courses.

question: High-paying occupations in healthcare
cypher:
MATCH (col:College {name: $college})-[:IN_MARKET]->(r:Region)-[d:DEMANDS]->(occ:Occupation)-[:REQUIRES_SKILL]->(sk:Skill)<-[:DEVELOPS]-(course:Course {college: $college})
WHERE toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'health' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'nurse' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'medical' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'clinical' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'care' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'patient' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'physician' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'dental' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'pharmacy' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'therapy' OR toLower(occ.title) CONTAINS 'therapist'
RETURN occ.soc_code AS soc_code, occ.title AS title,
       occ.description AS description, d.annual_wage AS annual_wage,
       d.employment AS employment, d.growth_rate AS growth_rate,
       d.annual_openings AS annual_openings, occ.education_level AS education_level,
       count(DISTINCT sk) AS matching_skills,
       collect(DISTINCT sk.name) AS skills
ORDER BY d.annual_wage DESC
interpretation: This query finds healthcare-related occupations in College of the Desert's regional labor market — including roles in nursing, medical, clinical, therapy, dental, and pharmacy fields — ranked by annual wage from highest to lowest, showing only those with skill alignment to courses offered at College of the Desert.
